info.title: API.SH: Daraz
info.description: The Daraz API from API.SH: public Daraz data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

get.description:
One Daraz product: title, brand, price, discount, currency, stock, rating with star breakdown and review count, seller, category, images, variant options and SKUs, and the description. Each SKU in `variants` also has `available` (can be added to cart), `cart_label` and `max_quantity` (per order).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/daraz-product

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Daraz product link.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words instead of url: the first product the catalog lists for them is returned.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Daraz country for q (default pk): pk, bd, lk, np or mm.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Daraz product's reviews: rating, text, author, date, purchase date, verified purchase, helpful votes, variant bought, photos and seller replies, with the rating summary, star filter, sort and paging.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/daraz-reviews

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Daraz product link.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Product id instead of url (with country).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country for id (default pk).

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with these stars (1-5).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Reviews per page, 1-50 (default 20).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Daraz catalog search (Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Nepal, Myanmar): id, title, link, price, original price, discount, rating, review count, sold count, seller, brand, location, stock, images and badges, with category, brand and price filters and sorts, plus every filter the catalog lists with its options (`filters[].param` names the search parameter that takes a filter's option values). Also filters by minimum star rating, service and promotion (free delivery, mall, flash sale...), where it ships from and product attributes (warranty, colour...); the answer echoes them as `applied_filters`. Several values of one filter must all apply.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/daraz-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words (or category).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Daraz country (default pk).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category path from the filters, e.g. smartphones.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand values from the filters, comma separated (e.g. samsung).

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest price (local currency).

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest price.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only products rated this many stars and up (1-5).

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: Service & promotion values from `filters[name=service]`, comma separated (e.g. Free_Shipping, reseller for mall, flashsale, New_Arrival).

parameters.name: free_shipping
parameters.description: true: only products with free delivery (same as service=Free_Shipping).

parameters.name: mall
parameters.description: true: only mall (official store) products (same as service=reseller).

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Where it ships from, values from `filters[name=location]`, comma separated (e.g. Punjab).

parameters.name: attribute
parameters.description: Attribute values from `filters[name=attribute]` (warranty type, colour family, delivery option...), comma separated, e.g. 7:265854.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Daraz shop and its products: shop id, seller id and name, and the shop's catalog with name, id, link, price, original price, discount, rating, review count, location, stock, image, brand, categories, with the rating, price and category filters and the sort options. Search inside the shop with `q`, filter by price range or minimum stars, sort by popularity or price. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/daraz-seller

parameters.name: shop
parameters.description: The shop slug from the shop's link (daraz.pk/shop/<slug>), or the link itself.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country site (default pk).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words inside the shop (default: all products).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (default relevance).

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest price in whole units of the local currency.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest price in whole units of the local currency.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only products rated this many stars and up (1-5).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The search box suggestions Daraz shows for a partial term, in Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Nepal or Myanmar.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/daraz-suggest

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The partial search term.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Daraz site (default pk).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
